title: Airfoil2Vec: Spectral Geometry-Conditioned Neural Surrogate Models for Airfoil Aerodynamics and a Downforce-Generating CFD Dataset
abstract: arXiv:2609.38213v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We introduce a dataset of approximately 10,000 Reynolds-Averaged Navier-Stokes (RANS) simulations of steady, incompressible, two-dimensional subsonic flow around downforce-generating NACA 4-digit airfoils, targeting aerodynamic regimes relevant to automotive and motorsport applications (openly available on https://huggingface.co/datasets/ratiolabs/downforce-airfoils). Using this resource, we study geometry-conditioned neural surrogates for fast flow prediction, comparing neural fields with neural ODEs, MLPs with graph-based models, and several spectral geometry-conditioning methods. We further propose Airfoil2Vec, an airfoil-specific spectral geometry encoder that combines the joint contour spectrum with separate spectral representations of camber and thickness, for predicting continuous pressure and velocity fields. We evaluate generalization through angle-of-attack interpolation, interpolation and extrapolation to unseen NACA 4-digit

translated_title: Airfoil2Vec：用于翼型空气动力学的谱几何条件神经代理模型及下压力生成CFD数据集
translated_abstract: 我们介绍了一个包含约10,000个雷诺平均Navier-Stokes（RANS）模拟的数据集，这些模拟针对产生下压力的NACA 4位数翼型的定常、不可压缩、二维亚音速流动，面向与汽车和赛车运动应用相关的空气动力学状态（数据集已在 https://huggingface.co/datasets/ratiolabs/downforce-airfoils 公开提供）。利用这一资源，我们研究了用于快速流场预测的几何条件神经代理模型，比较了神经场与神经常微分方程（Neural ODE）、多层感知机（MLP）与基于图的模型，以及多种谱几何条件化方法。我们进一步提出了Airfoil2Vec，这是一种专门针对翼型的谱几何编码器，它将联合轮廓谱与弯度和厚度的独立谱表示相结合，用于预测连续的压力场和速度场。我们通过迎角插值以及对未见过的NACA 4位数翼型的插值和外推来评估模型的泛化能力。
tldr: 本文提出了Airfoil2Vec翼型专用谱几何编码器和包含约10,000个RANS模拟的下压力翼型CFD公开数据集，能够快速准确地预测翼型周围连续的压力场和速度场。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Airfoil2Vec, an airfoil-specific spectral geometry encoder, together with a publicly available CFD dataset of ~10,000 RANS simulations of downforce-generating airfoils, enabling fast and accurate prediction of continuous pressure and velocity fields around airfoils.
